name: module-size-scope
body: Scope and observable completion for the decomposition law. It applies repo-wide over first-party source, excluding vendored code (`src/cpplib/vendor/**`) and testdata (`testdata/**`): the root Rust crate (`src/*.rs` + `build.rs`) and the eight frontend crates — `structlib` (`src/structlib/src/main.rs`), `pylib` (`src/pylib/src/main.rs`), `rustlib` (`src/rustlib/src/main.rs`), `cpplib` (`src/cpplib/main.cpp` + its non-vendor sources), `javalib` (`src/javalib/CallGraphBuilder.java`), `golib` (`src/golib/main.go`), `csharplib` (`src/csharplib/Program.cs`), `tslib` (`src/tslib/scanner.ts`). Test files (`src/<module>/tests.rs`, `tests/**`) are not production source and are accounted separately, as are the frontend crates' own test files. Completion is observable by review of the module set — module names and responsibilities, and a duplicated-symbol inventory — not by a line-count threshold; the ~400-line figure is a signal (`domain.value.module-size-signal`), never a target, and a split that hits the number without improving cohesion is itself a violation.
